lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.english: How many people are in your family?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge hé wǒ.
lines.english: There are four people in my family: dad, mom, older brother, and me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How old is your older brother?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 他二十岁。他在北京上大学。
lines.pinyin: Tā èrshí suì. Tā zài Běijīng shàng dàxué.
lines.english: He is twenty years old. He studies at university in Beijing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你爸爸妈妈做什么工作？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba māma zuò shénme gōngzuò?
lines.english: What work do your dad and mom do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。
lines.pinyin: Bàba shì yīshēng, māma shì lǎoshī.
lines.english: Dad is a doctor, mom is a teacher.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ ài nǐ de jiārén ma?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ hěn ài tāmen.
lines.english: Yes, I love them very much.
